dedupe_keys.name: swat model setup namal watershed and validation dataset

description: Hamza Tariq at New Jersey Institute of Technology publishes a configured SWAT+ rainfall-runoff model for the Namal watershed. The February 2025 deposit supplies soil, land-use and weather-generator CSV inputs, a TxtInOut archive with calibration and watershed parameters, and ICON forecast data used to validate a reservoir streamflow-forecasting system. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. The package can reproduce catchment inflows used by a scenario-based reservoir-operation study, although this inventory does not confirm a complete stochastic control implementation. The forecast archive name identifies 26 March 2024; broader simulation and calibration periods, model version and spatial discretisation remain unknown. The source does not explicitly establish the watershed's country, so none is assigned. A first-review record covers SWAT software generally, but does not include this configured watershed. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies this setup. Resource files and execution were not checked.
